title: Create real estate channel partner management application

requirements.text: Create a partner registration system where channel partners can sign up with their name, company name, contact details, and license information
acceptanceCriteria: Partners can register with required fields: name, company, email, phone, license number
Registration data is stored in the backend
Form validation ensures all required fields are filled

requirements.text: Implement a property listing dashboard where partners can view available real estate properties with details like location, price, type, and status
acceptanceCriteria: Dashboard displays list of properties with key information
Properties show location, price, property type, and availability status
Partners can filter or search properties

requirements.text: Create a lead management system where partners can add, track, and manage customer leads with status tracking
acceptanceCriteria: Partners can add new leads with customer name, contact, interested property, and budget
Lead status can be tracked (new, contacted, site visit scheduled, negotiation, closed)
Partners can view all their leads in a list

requirements.text: Build a commission tracking feature that shows partners their earned commissions, pending amounts, and payment history
acceptanceCriteria: Dashboard shows total earned commissions and pending payments
Partners can see commission breakdown by property/deal
Payment history is accessible with dates and amounts

requirements.text: Implement partner authentication using Internet Identity so partners can securely log in and access their personalized dashboard
acceptanceCriteria: Partners can log in using Internet Identity
Each partner sees only their own data after login
Unauthenticated users are redirected to login

requirements.text: Create a visually appealing, professional interface with a modern real estate industry aesthetic featuring warm earth tones, clean layouts, and property-focused imagery that conveys trust and professionalism
acceptanceCriteria: UI uses a cohesive color palette with warm, professional tones
Layout is clean, organized, and easy to navigate
Design conveys trust and suits real estate business context

requirements.text: Display generated hero banner and property placeholder images as static assets from frontend/public/assets/generated
acceptanceCriteria: Hero banner image is displayed on the main dashboard
Property placeholder images are used in property listings
Images load from static assets directory

constraints: Use Internet Identity for authentication only
All partner data must be isolated per authenticated user
Store all business logic in a single Motoko actor
nonGoals: Integration with external real estate listing services
